question: Does the typed checkpoint-bound structural learner state predict the vector of future transfer gain/harm from an equal-cost candidate exposure beyond generic learner-state proxies and the strongest fair adaptive parent features?

subject.model_family: Qwen2.5-7B exact revision used by frozen Paper-IV Phase-2

prediction_unit: checkpoint x candidate exposure type x structural family

GENERIC: model-aware NLL/influence proxy used by strongest frozen parent

design.cross_fitting: No future-gain outcome may be used to construct features or fit the predictor that scores that held-out checkpoint/candidate unit.
design.freshness: Use disjoint future exposures/outcomes from the Phase-1 instrument rows that motivated the question; the existing Phase-1 terminal rows are development/history, not assurance.
losses: proper probabilistic/calibration loss for harm events
held-out squared/absolute error for signed gain coordinates
rank correlation for equal-cost candidate ordering
design.statistics: paired held-out unit differences with bootstrap confidence intervals; family-wise correction across registered primary coordinates

hard_falsifiers: generic-plus-structural does not improve held-out predictive loss/ranking beyond the strongest generic model
apparent improvement disappears on fresh structural families/checkpoints
structural identity is reconstructed from future outcome or leaked assurance labels
a simpler parent feature set is sufficient

terminals.STRUCTURAL_INFORMATION_RESIDUAL_SUPPORTE: The structural increment improves preregistered held-out prediction/ranking beyond the strongest generic feature set without harm-calibration regression.
terminals.GENERIC_PARENT_SUFFICIENT: The strongest generic/model-aware predictor matches or beats generic-plus-structural.
terminals.STRUCTURAL_SIGNAL_NOT_GENERAL: Development information exists but fresh family/checkpoint assurance does not replicate.
terminals.UNDERPOWERED: Intervals remain too wide for the preregistered material predictive difference.
terminals.INVALID_LEAKAGE_OR_INSTRUMENT: Feature/outcome chronology, partitioning, or proxy computation is invalid.

non_claims: This protocol does not establish allocation-policy value; that is Paper-IV Q2.
It does not establish train-to-inference identity reuse; that is Q3.
It grants no scientific or publication authority before execution.
